title: Battle of Orbulaq
text: The Battle of Orbulaq was fought in 1643 between Jangir Khan of the Kazakh Khanate with the support of the Emir of Samarkand, Yalangto'sh Bakhodir of Khanate of Bukhara against the khong tayiji Erdeni Batur of Dzungar Khanate, resulting in the defeat of the Dzungar army.
